packets.title: S003 Al-Imran CP01 vv001-032
paragraphs: Why this cut: Stops before 3:33 (family of ʿImrān / Mary).
Surah tag: Medinan by the traditional list

Alif lām mīm. God: no god but He, the Living, the Self-Subsisting. He sent down the Book on you with truth, confirming what is before it, and He sent down the Torah and the Injīl before as guidance for people, and He sent down the Furqān. Those who disbelieve in God’s signs: severe punishment. Nothing is hidden from Him in earth or heaven. He forms you in the wombs as He wills. He sent down the Book; in it are muḥkamāt — they are the mother of the Book — and others mutashābihāt. Those with deviation follow what is mutashābih, seeking fitnah and seeking its taʾwīl; none knows its taʾwīl except God. Those firm in knowledge say we believe in it; all is from our Lord. Our Lord, do not deviate our hearts after You have guided us. Our Lord, You will gather people for a day in which there is no doubt. Neither wealth nor children of those who disbelieve will avail. Like Pharaoh’s folk and those before them: they denied Our signs. You have already had a sign in two companies that met — one fighting in God’s way, the other kāfir — they saw them twice their number with the eye. Beautified for people is love of desires. Say: shall I tell you of better than that? Gardens, spouses, God’s pleasure. The patient, truthful, obedient, spenders, seekers of forgiveness at dawn. God witnesses that there is no god but He, and the angels and those of knowledge, upholding justice. The dīn with God is al-islām. Those given the Book did not differ except after knowledge came to them, out of baghy among themselves. If they argue with you, say I have submitted my face to God, and whoever follows me. Say to those given the Book and the ummiyyūn: have you submitted? If they aslama they are guided; if they turn away, upon you is only the proclamation. Those who disbelieve in God’s signs and kill the prophets without right and kill those who command equity: give them tidings of a painful punishment. Have you not seen those given a portion of the Book? They are invited to the Book of God to judge between them; then a party of them turns away. That is because they say the Fire will not touch us except numbered days. How will it be when We gather them for a day in which there is no doubt. Say: O God, Owner of kingship, You give kingship to whom You will. You make the night enter the day. You provide whom You will without reckoning. Let not the believers take the disbelievers as awliyāʾ rather than believers. Say if you hide what is in your breasts or show it, God knows it. On the day every soul finds what it did of good present, and what it did of evil, it will wish there were a far span between it and that. Say: if you love God, follow me; God will love you and forgive you. Obey God and the messenger.
3:3–4 Torah and Injīl named as sent down

The Book on “you” is sent down with truth, muṣaddiqan li-mā bayna yadayhi. Torah and Injīl were sent down before as guidance for people; the Furqān is sent down. First time this surah names both prior books as tanzīl. Thickens QCA-0004 / QRQ-0003: they are guidance, they are confirmed, they are not here called corrupted files. Difference-after-knowledge is blamed on baghy (3:19), not yet on a rewritten text.

Two classes of āyāt. Mother of the Book = the muḥkamāt. People of zaygh chase the mutashābih for fitnah and taʾwīl. Pause after “except God” or after “except God and those firm in knowledge” is a famous reading split. Level 1 records both punctuations as live. This verse is the Quran’s own warning against using ambiguous lines as a playground.
A sign: two hosts met; one in God’s way, one kāfir; they saw them twice themselves. Traditional asbāb: Badr. The verse does not name the battle. Tag TRADITION for the proper name.
3:19–20 the dīn with God is al-islām
Inna l-dīna ʿinda llāhi l-islām. Those given the Book differed after knowledge, out of baghy. Submit the face; if they aslama they are guided; if not, only the balāgh is on you.

Islām here can be heard as the generic submission already used of Abraham in 2:131–133, or as the named dīn of this messenger. Both hearings exist in the tradition. 3:85 (not yet in this packet) will say whoever seeks a dīn other than islām, it will not be accepted. 2:62 named reward for Jews, Christians, and Sabians who believe in God and the Last Day and do ṣāliḥ work. QI-0004 is now active: 2:62 / 3:19, with 3:85 still to come. Do not let 3:19 silently delete 2:62 before 3:85 is read in its own packet.

QB-0064: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with “one God, one allegiance” claims in both Testaments (Shema; “I am the way” in John 14 is a different exclusivism). 3:19 is a dīn-name claim, not yet a full soteriology verse.
3:21 kill the prophets; 3:23 portion of the Book
Prophet-killing again (2:61, 2:87, 2:91). They are invited to the Book of God to judge between them; a party turns away. Numbered days in the Fire — same boast-structure as 2:80.
God gives and strips mulk, honors and abases, folds night into day, provides without ḥisāb. Continuity with 2:247 (God gives kingship to whom He wills).

Believers are not to take disbelievers as awliyāʾ rather than believers. Exception: unless you guard against them in precaution (tuqātan) — a famous exception later used for concealment under threat. If you love God, follow me; God will love you. Obey God and the messenger. First “follow me → God loves you” formula in the reading order.
Hayy qayyum again; forms in the wombs; Owner of mulk; loves those who follow the messenger.
Torah and Injil sent down as guidance; Book confirms what is before it; difference after knowledge is baghy; portion of the Book + invitation to God's Book.
Follow me and God will love you; obey God and the messenger.
Muhkam / mutashabih as an internal theory of the Book.
3:19 din with God is islam — live with 2:62; wait for 3:85.
Book sent down confirming; Torah and Injil sent down before as guidance
Muhkam and mutashabih; only God (and/or the firm) know ta'wil
The din with God is al-islam; Book-recipients differed after knowledge from baghy
Invited to the Book of God to judge; numbered-days boast
Do not take disbelievers as awliya; if you love God follow me

Āl ʿImrān opens by naming Torah and Injīl as sent-down guidance and by stating that the dīn with God is islām. The Book contains clear lines and resembling lines; chasing the latter for fitnah is condemned. 2:62 is not cancelled by 3:19 on this page. Mary’s family begins at 3:33.
Next: S003 CP02 = 3:33–63 (ʿImrān, Mary, Zechariah, John, the annunciation of Jesus, clay bird, disciples — the comparison core of this surah).

packets.title: S003 Al-Imran CP02 vv033-063
paragraphs: Figures: Adam, Noah, Abraham, ʿImrān, Mary, Zechariah, John, Jesus

God chose Adam, Noah, the family of Abraham, and the family of ʿImrān over the worlds — offspring one of another. The wife of ʿImrān: I have vowed to You what is in my womb, consecrated. When she delivered: I have delivered a female — God knew what she delivered — and the male is not like the female. I have named her Maryam; I seek refuge in You for her and her offspring from Satan the accursed. Her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and made her grow well, and Zechariah took charge of her. Whenever Zechariah entered the miḥrāb he found provision. Mary: it is from God; God provides whom He wills without reckoning. There Zechariah called his Lord: give me from Yourself good offspring. The angels called him while he stood praying in the miḥrāb: God gives you good tidings of Yaḥyā, confirming a word from God, a sayyid, chaste, a prophet from the ṣāliḥīn. He: how, when old age has reached me and my wife is barren? God does what He wills. Sign: you will not speak to people three days except by gesture. Mary: God has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. O Mary, be devoutly obedient, prostrate, bow with those who bow. That is from the news of the unseen We reveal to you; you were not with them when they cast their lots as to which of them should take charge of Mary. The angels: O Mary, God gives you good tidings of a word from Him; his name is the Messiah, Jesus son of Mary, distinguished in this world and the hereafter, of those brought near. He will speak to people in the cradle and in maturity, of the ṣāliḥīn. She: how, when no man has touched me? God creates what He wills; when He decrees a matter He only says to it Be, and it is. He will teach him the Book and ḥikmah and the Torah and the Injīl, and a messenger to the Children of Israel: I have come to you with a sign from your Lord — I create for you from clay the likeness of a bird, breathe into it, it becomes a bird by God’s leave; I heal the born-blind and the leper and give life to the dead by God’s leave; I tell you what you eat and store. Confirming the Torah before me, and to make lawful some of what was forbidden to you. God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. When Jesus felt kufr from them: who are my helpers to God? The ḥawāriyyūn: we are God’s helpers; we believe in God; witness that we are muslimūn. They plotted; God plotted; God is the best of plotters. God: O Jesus, I will take you and raise you to Myself and purify you from those who disbelieve, and make those who follow you above those who disbelieve to the Day of Rising. Then to Me is your return. This is what We recite. The likeness of Jesus with God is as the likeness of Adam: He created him from dust, then said to him Be, and he is. The truth from your Lord; do not be of the doubters. Whoever argues with you after this knowledge: come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then pray earnestly and lay the curse of God on the liars. This is the true story. God is my Lord and your Lord; worship Him.

Four chosen lines: Adam, Noah, Āl Ibrāhīm, Āl ʿImrān. The wife of ʿImrān vows the child; she expected a male; God accepts a female. Mary is named, given refuge from Satan, raised in the miḥrāb under Zechariah, fed by unseen provision.

QB-0065: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with Luke 1’s pairing of a temple-linked Mary and an aged Zechariah. DIFFERENCE: in Luke, Zechariah is husband of Elizabeth, Mary’s relative; Mary is of Nazareth, visited at home. Here Zechariah is Mary’s guardian in a sanctuary. ʿImrān as Mary’s father is not a Gospel name (Gospel: Jacob father of Joseph in Matt 1; Heli in Luke 3; Mary’s father is unnamed). Later Christian and Muslim lists sometimes align ʿImrān with Joachim — that is extra-textual for both canons.
Zechariah asks; angels announce Yaḥyā, confirming a word from God, sayyid, ḥaṣūr, prophet. Sign: three days without speech except gesture.

QB-0066: AGREEMENT with Luke 1:5–25, 57–66 on aged/barren parents, named John, father’s speech taken as a sign. DIFFERENCE: Luke’s sign is muteness until the child is named; here three days and gesture is allowed. “Confirming a word from God” points forward to Jesus as kalima (3:45). John is ḥaṣūr (chaste / withheld from women) — closer to the austere John of the Gospels than to a married-prophet profile.
3:42–51 Mary and the annunciation; Jesus’ brief

Mary chosen above the women of the worlds. Tidings of a word from Him; name: al-Masīḥ ʿĪsā ibn Maryam. Speaks in the cradle and in maturity. Virgin protest: no bashar has touched me. Kun fa-yakūn. Curriculum: Book, ḥikmah, Torah, Injīl. Mission to Banī Isrāʾīl. Signs: clay bird by leave; born-blind and leper healed by leave; dead given life by leave; knowledge of food stored. Confirms Torah; makes lawful some of what was forbidden. Worship God, my Lord and your Lord.

QB-0067 Luke 1:26–38: AGREEMENT on virgin, angelic tidings, named son, greatness. DIFFERENCE: Luke names the child Jesus, Son of the Most High, throne of David, no end of kingdom. The Quran names him Messiah son of Mary, a word, one brought near — and will spend 3:59 blocking sonship-by-unusual-birth.
QB-0068 cradle speech: NOT in the four Gospels. PRESENT in the Arabic Infancy Gospel / related infancy cycles. Flag as EXTRA-CANONICAL CHRISTIAN PARALEL, not as NT. Do not call it “the Bible.”
QB-0069 clay bird: NOT in the four Gospels. PRESENT in Infancy Gospel of Thomas. Same flag: extra-canonical Christian narrative, not Matthew–John.
QB-0070 healings and raising the dead: AGREEMENT with Gospel miracle types (blind, leper, dead). The refrain bi-idhni llāh is the Quran’s fence: Jesus does not act as an independent source of life.

QB-0071 “make lawful some of what was forbidden”: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with Gospel controversy over Sabbath, purity, and food (Mark 2–7; Matt 5:17–20 is “not to abolish”). The Quranic Jesus both confirms Torah and loosens some bans. How that sits with Matt 5:17 is a live tension, not a merge.

Ḥawāriyyūn declare themselves muslimūn and God’s helpers. They plotted; God is best of plotters. 3:55: innī mutawaffīka wa-rāfiʿuka ilayya — I will take you and raise you to Me, and purify you from those who disbelieve. Tawaffī elsewhere often means death; rāfiʿuka is raising. The two verbs together are the hinge later readers split: death-then-raise vs take-then-raise-without-death. 4:157 is not in this packet. Level 1 here: God takes Jesus and raises him and will make his followers above the disbelievers until the Rising. Do not import the 4:157 crucifixion-denial sentence yet as if it were already spoken.

Mathal ʿĪsā ʿinda llāhi ka-mathali Ādam: created from dust, then Kun. Unusual birth is not sonship; Adam had neither father nor mother. 3:61: mutual curse after knowledge — the Najrān-asbāb is TRADITION. 3:62: this is the true story. Worship God.

QB-0072: the Adam–Jesus analogy is the Quran’s explicit counter to reading virgin birth as divinity. Paul (Rom 5; 1 Cor 15) also pairs Adam and Jesus, in the opposite direction (first man / last Adam, death / life). Same two names; different use.
PARTIAL AGREEMENT with Luke 1 pairing; different household map
AGREEMENT with Luke 1; three-day sign vs until-naming
AGREEMENT on virgin tidings; DIFFERENCE on Davidic throne / Son of Most High
NOT in four Gospels; infancy-gospel parallel
NOT in four Gospels; Infancy Gospel of Thomas parallel
AGREEMENT of type; fenced by bi-idhni Allah
Confirm Torah and loosen some bans
SAME pairing as Paul; OPPOSITE argument
Chosen lines; wife of Imran vows Mary; Zechariah her guardian
Yahya announced to aged Zechariah; three-day sign
Mary chosen; Messiah Jesus a word; speaks in cradle; kun
Clay bird, healings, dead raised by leave; confirms Torah; loosens some bans
Hawariyyun muslimun; God takes and raises Jesus
Jesus like Adam from dust; mubahala; this is the true story

This block is why the surah is named Āl ʿImrān. Jesus is Messiah, son of Mary, a word, created as Adam was created, miracle-worker only by leave, confirmer of Torah, not a son by virtue of missing a father. Gospel agreements cluster on virgin announcement, John, and healing types. Cradle and clay bird sit with infancy gospels, not with Matthew–John.
Next: 3:64–80 or 3:64–99 (People of the Book invitation, Abraham was not a Jew or Christian, 3:85). 3:85 should not be delayed long because QI-0004 is waiting on it.

packets.title: S003 Al-Imran CP03 vv064-091
paragraphs: Load-bearing: 3:67 Abraham ḥanīf muslim; 3:85 whoever seeks other than islām

Say: People of the Book, come to a word common between us and you: that we worship none but God, associate nothing with Him, and do not take one another as lords besides God. If they turn away: bear witness that we are muslimūn. Why do you argue about Abraham when the Torah and Injīl were not sent down until after him? Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian; he was ḥanīfan musliman and not of the mushrikīn. The nearest of people to Abraham are those who followed him, this prophet, and those who believe. A party of the People of the Book wish to mislead you. A party say believe in what was sent down on those who believe at the face of day and disbelieve at its end. Do not believe anyone except those who follow your dīn. Say: the true guidance is God’s guidance. Among the People of the Book is one who if entrusted with a qinṭār pays it back; among them is one who if entrusted with a dīnār will not pay it unless you stand over him — because they say we have no way against the ummiyyīn. They say it is from God when it is not. A party twist their tongues with the Book so you will think it is from the Book; it is not from the Book. They say it is from God; it is not. It is not for a human that God should give him the Book, ḥukm, and nubuwwa, then he say to people be servants to me besides God. Rather: be rabbāniyyīn. He would not command you to take angels and prophets as lords. When God took the covenant of the prophets: whatever I give you of Book and ḥikmah, then there comes to you a messenger confirming what is with you — you shall believe in him and help him. They said we affirm. Whoever turns away after that: the fāsiqūn. Do they seek other than God’s dīn, when to Him submitted whoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly? Whoever seeks a dīn other than al-islām, it will not be accepted from him, and in the hereafter he is among the losers. How shall God guide a people who disbelieved after their belief, and witnessed that the messenger is true, and clear proofs came to them? Those: their repayment is that on them is the curse of God, the angels, and the people all together, abiding in it; the punishment is not lightened. Except those who repent after that and put things right. Those who disbelieve after their belief then increase in kufr: their repentance will not be accepted. Those who disbelieve and die as disbelievers: there will not be accepted from any of them the earth full of gold even if he ransomed himself with it.

Kalimatin sawāʾ: worship none but God, no shirk, no taking one another as lords. If they turn: witness that we are muslimūn. This is the most explicit invitation-formula to Jews and Christians in the reading so far. It assumes a shared monotheism that can be named as a meeting-point, then draws a line at human lordship.

QB-0073: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with Shema / first commandment and with Jesus’ “the Lord our God, the Lord is one” (Mark 12:29). “Do not take one another as lords” is the edge aimed at structures of religious mediation (later tafsir aims this at rabbis and at high Christology). Level 1 is the sentence, not the later target-list.
3:65–68 Abraham was not a Jew or a Christian

Torah and Injīl came after Abraham; therefore he cannot be claimed by those later names. He was ḥanīfan musliman, not a mushrik. Nearest to him: those who followed him, this prophet, and the believers. God is walī of the believers.

Repeats and hardens 2:135–140. Abraham is pulled out of both later communities and seated as ḥanīf muslim. “Muslim” here is the same root as 3:19 and 3:85; whether it is generic submitter or the named dīn is the whole argument of this surah.

QB-0074: CONTRAST with Gen 12–17 + later Jewish claim of Abraham as first Jew / father of the covenant people, and with Pauline / Gospel use of Abraham as father of those who believe (Rom 4; Gal 3; John 8). All three files claim him. The Quran’s move is chronological: the later labels do not reach back to him.

Wish to mislead. Believe in the morning, disbelieve in the evening — a social-pressure tactic. Do not trust anyone except your own dīn. Two kinds of trustee: qinṭār paid back vs dīnār withheld because “we have no way against the ummiyyīn.” They say it is from God and it is not. A party twist their tongues with the Book so you think it from the Book. QCA-0003 (tahrīf / twisting) is now tongue-and-speech, not yet a claim that every manuscript is rewritten. Keep that distinction.

A human given Book, ḥukm, and nubuwwa does not then say “be my servants besides God.” Be rabbāniyyīn. He does not command taking angels and prophets as lords. Then a covenant taken from the prophets: when a confirming messenger comes, believe and help. This is the Quran’s theory of why later communities “should have” recognized this messenger: a prior prophetic pact. Level 1 is the claim; the pact is not quoted from a named biblical verse.
QB-0075: POSSIBLE RELATIONSHIP to Deut 18:15–19 (a prophet like Moses) and to John 5:46 (Moses wrote of me) as “prior confirmation” claims. Not identity of wording.

Do they seek other than God’s dīn, when whoever is in the heavens and the earth submitted to Him, willing or unwilling? Wa-man yabtaghi ghayra l-islāmi dīnan fa-lan yuqbala minhu — whoever seeks a dīn other than al-islām, it will not be accepted from him; in the hereafter he is among the losers.
Now the three sentences are on one table:
2:62 — those who believe, and the Jews, the Christians, and the Sabians — who believe in God and the Last Day and do ṣāliḥ work — their reward is with their Lord; no fear, no grief.
3:19 — the dīn with God is al-islām; Book-recipients differed after knowledge from baghy.
3:85 — whoever seeks other than al-islām as dīn: not accepted; loser in the hereafter.

Possible hearings, all of which must be listed rather than one smuggled in as “the” reading: (1) islām in 3:85 is generic submission, so 2:62 still describes people who actually submit; (2) islām in 3:85 is the named dīn of this messenger, so 2:62 is earlier, abrogated, or restricted to pre-mission people; (3) 2:62 already required the right God and Last Day, and 3:85 names that right allegiance as islām. Naskh of 2:62 by 3:85 is a Level 4 uṣūl move. Level 1: both verses stand in the muṣḥaf. QI-0004 stays OPEN.

How will God guide a people who disbelieved after belief, having witnessed that the messenger is true? Curse of God, angels, and people. Exception: those who repent and repair. Those who disbelieve after belief then increase in kufr: repentance not accepted. Those who die as disbelievers: earth-full of gold will not ransom them. This is post-recognition apostasy language, not the 2:62 file.
CONTRAST with Jewish and Christian claims on Abraham; same contest as Rom 4 / John 8
Prophet-covenant to believe the confirming messenger
Common word: no worship but God; no human lords
Abraham neither Jew nor Christian; hanif muslim; nearest are those who follow him and this prophet
Twist tongues with the Book; say it is from God and it is not
No prophet says be my servants; covenant of the prophets to help the confirming messenger
Whoever seeks a din other than al-islam: not accepted
Kufr after witnessing the messenger; gold will not ransom the dead disbeliever

Abraham is removed from both later labels and seated as ḥanīf muslim. A common word is offered, then 3:85 states that a dīn other than islām will not be accepted. 2:62 remains in the Book. The project does not pretend those two sentences are the same sentence.
Next: 3:92–120 (spend what you love; Israel’s food; first House at Bakka; among them a just ummah; do not take intimates from outside).

packets.title: S003 Al-Imran CP04 vv092-120
paragraphs: You will not attain birr until you spend of what you love. All food was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel forbade himself before the Torah was sent down. Bring the Torah and recite it if you are truthful. Whoever invents a lie about God after that: the ẓālimūn. God has spoken truth; follow the millah of Abraham the ḥanīf; he was not of the mushrikīn. The first House set up for people is the one at Bakka, blessed, a guidance for the worlds. In it are clear signs: the standing-place of Abraham; whoever enters it is safe. To God upon people is ḥajj of the House for whoever can make a way to it; whoever disbelieves — God is free of need of the worlds. People of the Book: why do you disbelieve in God’s signs? Why do you bar from God’s way those who believe, seeking to make it crooked, while you are witnesses? If you obey a party of those given the Book they will turn you back after your belief into kāfirīn. How can you disbelieve while God’s signs are recited to you and among you is His messenger? Whoever holds fast to God is guided. Fear God as He should be feared; do not die except as muslimūn. Hold fast to the rope of God all together; do not divide. Remember when you were enemies and He joined your hearts. You were on the brink of a pit of Fire and He saved you. Let there be from you an ummah inviting to good, commanding maʿrūf, forbidding munkar. Do not be like those who divided and differed after clear proofs. On the day faces go white and faces go black. You are the best ummah brought forth for people: you command maʿrūf, forbid munkar, and believe in God. If the People of the Book had believed it would have been better for them; among them are believers; most are fāsiqūn. They will not harm you except harm; if they fight you they will turn their backs. Humiliation is stamped on them wherever they are caught except for a rope from God and a rope from the people. They incurred wrath; wretchedness was stamped — because they disbelieved in God’s signs and killed the prophets without right. They are not alike. Among the People of the Book is an ummah standing, reciting God’s signs in the watches of the night, prostrating; they believe in God and the Last Day, command maʿrūf, forbid munkar, hasten in good works; those are of the ṣāliḥīn. What they do of good will not be denied. Those who disbelieve: neither wealth nor children will avail. The likeness of what they spend in this life is a freezing wind that strikes the tillage of a people who wronged themselves. O believers, do not take intimates from outside yourselves; they spare no effort to ruin you; hatred has appeared from their mouths; what their breasts hide is greater. There you are, you love them and they do not love you; you believe in the Book, all of it. When they meet you they say we believe; when they are alone they bite their fingers at you. If good touches you it grieves them; if evil touches you they rejoice. If you endure and fear, their plot will not harm you.
Birr is not reached until the gift costs. Tightens 2:177 and 2:261–274.

All food was lawful to Banī Isrāʾīl except what Israel (Jacob) forbade himself before the Torah came down. Challenge: bring the Torah and recite it if you are truthful. Then: God has spoken truth; follow Abraham’s millah.

QB-0076: PARTIAL AGREEMENT that Israel’s food law is a later fence (Lev 11; Deut 14) rather than Adamic. The Quran’s claim is sharper: the full ḥarām-list arrives with Torah, plus a personal ban Jacob placed on himself (Gen 32:32 sinew is the usual tafsir hook — Level 4). “Bring the Torah” treats the book in their hands as something that can be recited in public as a check. That sits in tension with 3:78’s twisted-tongues charge: the same corpus is both appealable and accused of being mouthed wrongly.

Awwalu baytin wuḍiʿa li-l-nāsi la-lladhī bi-Bakkah. Blessed; guidance for the worlds. Clear signs; maqām Ibrāhīm; whoever enters is safe. Ḥajj of the House is upon people who can make a way. God does not need the worlds.

Bakka is received as Makkah (phonological variant). QB-0077: CONTRAST with the HB’s first-sanctuary story (tabernacle, then Jerusalem / Zion). Psalm 84:6 mentions ʿēmeq ha-bākā (“valley of Baca”) in a pilgrimage psalm toward Zion — a real verbal cousin, not identity of place. The Quran places the first House at Bakka and ties it to Abraham’s standing-place (already 2:125). Jerusalem is not named here.
3:100–109 rope; do not divide; an ummah inviting

Do not follow a party of the Book-people back into kufr. Hold to God. Die as muslimūn. Hold the rope of God together; do not divide. Enemy-to-brother memory. Let there be an ummah that invites to good, commands maʿrūf, forbids munkar. Do not imitate those who split after proofs. Faces white and black on the day.
3:110–115 best ummah; they are not alike

Kuntum khayra ummatin ukhrijat li-l-nās — you are the best ummah brought forth for people — on the condition named in the same breath: command maʿrūf, forbid munkar, believe in God. If the People of the Book believed it would be better; among them are believers; most are fāsiqūn. Harm without being able to finish you; if they fight they turn their backs. Humiliation stamped except for a rope from God or from people. Wrath and wretchedness because of signs-denied and prophets killed.
Then the brake: they are not alike. Among them is an ummah qāʾimah, reciting in the night, believing in God and the Last Day, commanding maʿrūf, of the ṣāliḥīn. Good they do is not denied.

QB-0078: PARTIAL AGREEMENT / REINTERPRETATION of chosen-people language (Exod 19:5–6; Deut 7; 1 Pet 2:9). The “best ummah” is task-defined (enjoin / forbid / believe), then immediately qualified: the People of the Book are not a single block. 3:113–114 is the closest thing in this surah to 2:62 still breathing after 3:85.

Do not take intimates from outside yourselves. They love your ruin; hatred shows in the mouth; the breast hides more. You love them; they do not love you; you believe in the Book, all of it. Two-faced greeting. If you endure and fear, their plot does not harm you. In-group caution after the “not alike” praise — both sentences stand.
Food lawful before Torah; bring the Torah
PARTIAL AGREEMENT that Mosaic food law is later; public-recitation challenge
CONTRAST with Zion/tabernacle as first sanctuary; Ps 84 Baca is a verbal cousin not a merge
Best ummah / they are not alike
REINTERPRETATION of chosen-people speech; 3:113 keeps a righteous Book-ummah in view
Birr requires spending what you love
All food lawful to Israel except Jacob's self-ban before Torah; bring the Torah
First House at Bakka; maqam Ibrahim; hajj on those who can
Hold the rope; do not divide; an ummah inviting to good
Best ummah; People of the Book not alike; a standing ummah among them
Do not take intimates from outside; you believe the Book all of it

Bakka is named the first House. The Torah is challenged to be recited in public. “Best ummah” is a task, not a race, and is followed at once by “they are not alike.” 3:113 is a remaining open window toward righteous People of the Book after 3:85.

Next: 3:121–148 or 3:121–179 (Uḥud cluster: the two groups, one-third turning back, the rumor the messenger was killed, those who died). Comparison to battle narratives is light; theology of defeat is the payload.

packets.title: S003 Al-Imran CP05 vv121-148
paragraphs: Asbab tag: Uḥud is TRADITION for 121–128 and 139–148; Badr is NAMED in 3:123

When you left your household at dawn posting the believers at stations for battle — God is hearing, knowing — when two parties among you were about to lose heart, though God was their walī. God had already helped you at Badr when you were lowly. When you said to the believers: is it not enough that your Lord reinforce you with three thousand angels sent down? Yes — if you endure and fear, and they come on you in this rush, your Lord will reinforce you with five thousand marked angels. God made it only as good news and so that your hearts be at rest; victory is only from God. That He might cut off a part of those who disbelieve or suppress them so they turn back disappointed. You have nothing of the matter; He turns to them or punishes them. To God belongs what is in the heavens and the earth; He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. O believers, do not eat ribā doubled and redoubled; fear God. Guard a Fire prepared for the kāfirīn. Obey God and the messenger that you may receive mercy. Race to forgiveness and a Garden as wide as the heavens and the earth prepared for the muttaqīn — who spend in ease and hardship, restrain rage, pardon people; God loves the muḥsinīn. Those who, when they do a fāḥisha or wrong themselves, remember God and ask forgiveness — and who forgives sins except God? — and do not persist. Their repayment: Gardens. Ways of practice have passed before you; travel in the land and see how the deniers ended. Do not weaken or grieve; you will be uppermost if you are believers. If a wound touches you, a like wound has touched the people. Those days We alternate among people so that God may know those who believe and take witnesses from you. God loves not the ẓālimīn. And that God may purge those who believe and wipe out the kāfirīn. Or did you think you would enter the Garden while God has not yet known those who struggle among you and those who endure? You were wishing for death before you met it; now you have seen it. Muḥammad is only a messenger; messengers have passed before him. If he dies or is killed, will you turn on your heels? Whoever turns on his heels will not harm God at all. God will repay the grateful. A soul does not die except by God’s leave, a named term. Whoever wants the reward of this world, We give him of it; whoever wants the reward of the hereafter, We give him of it. How many a prophet fought, with him many ribbiyyūn; they did not weaken for what hit them in God’s way, did not slacken, did not yield. Their only word was: our Lord forgive us our sins and our excess in our affair, make our feet firm, help us against the kāfir people. God gave them the reward of this world and the good reward of the hereafter.

Dawn posting; two parties about to fail; God their walī. Badr is the named prior help when they were low. Angel-reinforcement: 3,000 sent down; 5,000 marked if they endure and the enemy comes at once. The reinforcement is good news and heart-calm; naṣr is only from God. Cut off / suppress a portion of the disbelievers. You have nothing of the matter — He turns or punishes.

Uḥud as the occasion of 121–122 is asbāb (Bani Ḥārithah / Bani Salama in the reports). Level 1 does not name Uḥud. Badr is Level 1. Angel-counts are Level 1; identifying Gabriel or colored turbans is Level 4.
QB-0079: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with HB / NT war-help from heaven (2 Kgs 6:17; 19:35; Matt 26:53 twelve legions). Numbers and “marked” angels are this text’s own.
3:130–138 ethics dropped into the battle file

Ribā doubled and redoubled — a second ribā hit after 2:275. Fire prepared for kāfirīn. Obey God and the messenger. Race to a Garden wide as heavens and earth. Spend in ease and hardship; restrain ghayẓ; pardon people. When they do a fāḥisha or wrong themselves they remember God and ask forgiveness and do not persist. Travel and see the end of deniers. Do not weaken; you will be uppermost if you believe.

If a wound touches you, a like wound touched them. Days are rotated among people so God may know the believers and take shuhadāʾ, purge the believers, wipe out the kāfirīn. Did you think you would enter the Garden before struggle and ṣabr were known? You wished for death before you met it; now you have seen it. Same theology as 2:214.

Wa-mā Muḥammadun illā rasūlun qad khalat min qablihi l-rusul. If he dies or is killed, will you turn on your heels? Turning does not harm God. Grateful are repaid. A soul dies only by God’s leave, a named term.

First occurrence of the proper name Muḥammad in this surah (the other Quranic namings are 33:40, 47:2, 48:29). The sentence is a mortality-and-succession verse: messengers pass; the message does not. Asbāb: rumor at Uḥud that he had been killed. Later recitation at his actual death is TRADITION (Abū Bakr). Level 1 is the sentence itself.

QB-0080: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with the biblical pattern that prophets die and the word continues (Moses in Deut 34; “not to us but to your name” logic). CONTRAST with high-Christology claims that the central figure’s death is itself the saving act — here the feared death is a test of whether the community turns on its heels, not a claimed atonement.

Many a prophet fought, and with him large numbers of devoted men. They did not weaken at what hit them. Their word: forgive our sins and our excess; make our feet firm; help us. God gave world-reward and the good hereafter-reward. The Quran here assumes fighting prophets as a known class. Which HB figures count is tafsir (Moses, David, etc.).
named prior victory when they were low
you have nothing of the matter
large devoted bands with earlier prophets
PARTIAL AGREEMENT with heavenly-host war help
Messenger dies; community must not turn
PARTIAL AGREEMENT that prophets pass; CONTRAST with atonement-death as the point
Dawn posting; two parties falter; Badr help; 3000/5000 angels
You have nothing of the matter; doubled riba banned again
Garden after spend, restrained rage, pardon, tawba without persistence
Days rotated; Garden not before struggle is known
Muhammad is only a messenger; if he dies or is killed do not turn on your heels
Prophets fought with devoted bands; they did not weaken

Badr is named. Uḥud is the traditional frame. The theological payload is 3:144: the named messenger is mortal; turning on the heels after his death would not harm God. Angels calm the heart; victory is God’s.
Next: 3:149–180 (Satan frightens his allies; Uhud post-mortem: they went for the gains; a security-sleep; rumor; those who stayed). Then 3:181–200 closes the surah.

packets.title: S003 Al-Imran CP06 vv149-180
paragraphs: If you obey those who disbelieve they will turn you back on your heels and you will return as losers. God is your Mawlā; He is the best of helpers. We will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve because they associated with God that for which He sent down no authority. Their refuge is the Fire. God was true to His promise when you were killing them by His leave, until you failed and disputed about the matter and disobeyed after He showed you what you love. Among you are those who want this world and among you those who want the hereafter. Then He turned you from them that He might test you; He has pardoned you. When you were climbing, not turning aside for anyone, and the messenger was calling you from behind, He repaid you with distress upon distress so that you would not grieve for what escaped you or what hit you. Then after the grief He sent down on you security, a drowsiness covering a party of you, while another party were anxious for themselves, thinking of God other than the truth — the thought of jāhiliyya — saying: have we any part in the matter? Say: the matter is entirely God’s. They hide in themselves what they do not show you; they say: if we had any part in the matter we would not have been killed here. Say: if you had been in your houses, those for whom killing was written would have gone out to their dying-places. God tests what is in your breasts and purges what is in your hearts. Those of you who turned back the day the two hosts met — Satan made them slip for some of what they had earned; God has pardoned them. Do not be like those who disbelieved and said of their brothers when they traveled in the land or were raiding: if they had been with us they would not have died or been killed — so that God may make that a regret in their hearts. God gives life and causes death. If you are killed in God’s way or die, forgiveness and mercy from God are better than what they gather. If you die or are killed, to God you will be gathered. By a mercy from God you were lenient with them; had you been harsh-hearted they would have scattered from around you. Pardon them, ask forgiveness for them, consult them in the matter; when you have decided, rely on God. If God helps you, none can overcome you; if He abandons you, who is there after Him to help you? On God let the believers rely. It is not for a prophet to take ghulūl; whoever takes it will bring what he took on the Day of Rising. Is one who follows God’s pleasure like one who returns with displeasure? They are ranks with God. God conferred favor on the believers when He sent among them a messenger from themselves reciting His signs, purifying them, teaching them the Book and ḥikmah, though they were before in clear error. When a single disaster hit you, though you had hit them with one twice as great, you said: how is this? Say: it is from yourselves. What hit you the day the two hosts met was by God’s leave, that He might know the believers and know those who were hypocrites. It was said to them: come, fight in God’s way or defend. They said: if we knew fighting we would follow you. They were nearer to kufr that day than to belief. They say with their mouths what is not in their hearts. Those who stayed in their places and said to their brothers: come to us — if they had been obeyed none would have been killed. If a good thing touches you it grieves them; if a disaster hits you they say we took our precaution before. They are not of you and you are not of them. God is not about to leave the believers in the state you are in until He distinguishes the foul from the good. God is not about to acquaint you with the unseen, but God chooses from His messengers whom He wills. Those who believe, God will give them their reward. Let not those who withhold what God has given them of His bounty think it is good for them; it is bad for them. They will be collared with what they withheld on the Day of Rising. God has heard the saying of those who said God is poor and we are rich. We will write what they said and their killing of the prophets without right, and We will say taste the punishment of the burning.

Cut note: 3:181 belongs with the next packet’s “God is poor” file; the last sentence above runs to 3:181 in some recitation-blocks. This packet treats through 3:180 (withholding bounty). 3:181 will open CP07.
3:149–151 do not obey the disbelievers; terror

Obeying those who disbelieve turns you on your heels. God is Mawlā and best helper. Terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve because they associated what God gave no sulṭān for. Fire is the refuge.
3:152–155 why the turn; drowsiness; Satan slipped them

God was true while you were killing them by His leave until you failed, disputed, and disobeyed after He showed you what you love (the gains). Some want this world; some the hereafter. He turned you from them to test you; He has pardoned. Climbing, not turning for anyone, the messenger calling from behind — distress on distress so you would not grieve what escaped or what hit. Then security: nuʿās covering a party. Another party thought the jāhiliyya thought: have we any part in the matter? The matter is entirely God’s. If you had stayed home, those written for killing would have gone out to their places. Those who turned the day the two hosts met: Satan made them slip for some of what they earned; God pardoned.

Level 1 diagnosis of the reverse: dispute, disobedience after seeing desired spoils, mixed motives, then pardon. Named battle is still not in the verse. Drowsiness-as-amn is a reported Uḥud motif (Abū Ṭalḥa) — TRADITION for the identification.
3:156–158 do not talk like those who disbelieved about the dead

If they had been with us they would not have died. God makes that a regret in their hearts. God gives life and death. Killed in God’s way or dying: forgiveness and mercy better than what they gather. To God you are gathered.

By a mercy you were lenient; a harsh heart would have scattered them. Pardon; ask forgiveness; consult them in the matter; when you decide, rely on God. If God helps you none overcomes you; if He abandons you, no helper after Him. This is the Quran’s shūrā-plus-tawakkul sentence toward the named messenger.

A prophet does not take ghulūl (misappropriated spoil). Ranks with God. Favor: a messenger from themselves reciting, purifying, teaching Book and ḥikmah — they were in clear error before. Same purification-and-teaching clause as 2:129 / 2:151, now as already-sent favor.
3:165–175 how is this; hypocrites; Satan frightens his awliyāʾ

A disaster, though you had hit them twice as hard: how is this? It is from yourselves. What hit the day the two hosts met was by God’s leave, to know the believers and the hypocrites. Come fight or defend — they: if we knew fighting we would follow you. Nearer to kufr than to belief that day. Mouths not hearts. Those who stayed said come to us. Good grieves them; disaster they claim they anticipated. God will not leave the believers as you are until He distinguishes khabīth from ṭayyib. He will not give you the unseen; He chooses from the messengers whom He wills. Satan only frightens his own awliyāʾ; do not fear them, fear Me.
3:176–180 do not grieve over those who rush to kufr; withholding

They will not harm God. No share in the hereafter. Those who buy kufr with belief will not harm God. Let not those who withhold God’s bounty think it good; they will be collared with what they withheld. To God is the heritage of the heavens and the earth.
Do not obey disbelievers back onto your heels; God casts terror for shirk without sultan
You failed and disputed after seeing what you love; world-wanters vs hereafter-wanters; God pardoned
Security-drowsiness; jahiliyya thought about the matter; written deaths
Satan slipped those who turned; God pardoned; do not speak the if-they-had-been-with-us line
Leniency, consult them, then rely; if God helps none overcomes
No prophet takes ghulul; messenger from themselves teaching Book and hikmah
Disaster is from yourselves; hypocrites nearer kufr that day; Satan frightens his allies
Withheld bounty will collar them; heritage of heavens and earth is God's

The reverse is diagnosed as dispute-after-gains, mixed motives, and a jāhiliyya thought that the matter was theirs. God pardons the slip. The messenger is told to be lenient, to consult, then to rely. Hypocrites are sorted by the same day. Satan’s only move in 3:175 is frightening his own.
Next / last Āl ʿImrān packet: 3:181–200 (God is poor; messengers rejected; you will be tested in wealth and selves; usury of the Book-people; hold until the last verse).

packets.title: S003 Al-Imran CP07 vv181-200
paragraphs: S003 — ĀL ʿIMRĀN — CP07  ·  SURAH CLOSE

God has heard the saying of those who said God is poor and we are rich. We will write what they said and their killing of the prophets without right, and We will say taste the punishment of the burning. That is for what your hands sent ahead; God is not unjust to the servants. Those who said God has taken our promise not to believe a messenger until he brings an offering the fire consumes. Say: messengers came to you before me with the clear signs and with that which you said — why did you kill them if you are truthful? If they deny you, messengers before you were denied who came with the clear signs, the scriptures, and the illuminating Book. Every soul will taste death; you will be paid your wages in full on the Day of Rising. Whoever is drawn away from the Fire and admitted to the Garden has succeeded. The life of this world is only the enjoyment of delusion. You will surely be tested in your wealth and your selves, and you will hear from those given the Book before you and from those who associate much injury. If you endure and fear, that is of the resolve of affairs. When God took the covenant of those given the Book: you shall make it clear to the people and not conceal it. They threw it behind their backs and purchased with it a small price. Do not think those who rejoice in what they have brought and love to be praised for what they have not done — do not think them in safety from the punishment. To God belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. In the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of night and day are signs for those of hearts. Those who remember God standing, sitting, and on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth: our Lord, You did not create this in vain; glory to You; protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Our Lord, whoever You admit to the Fire You have disgraced; the ẓālimūn have no helpers. Our Lord, we heard a caller calling to faith: believe in your Lord — so we believed. Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affair, make our feet firm, and help us against the kāfir people. Our Lord, give us what You have promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Rising; You do not break the promise. Their Lord responded: I do not waste the work of a worker among you, male or female — you are of one another. Those who emigrated and were expelled from their homes and were harmed in My way and fought and were killed: I will surely wipe out their evils and admit them to Gardens. Do not be deceived by the turning about of those who disbelieve in the land — a little enjoyment, then their refuge is Jahannam. But those who fear their Lord: Gardens, a hospitality from God; what is with God is better for the abrār. Among the People of the Book are those who believe in God and what was sent down to you and what was sent down to them, humbling themselves to God; they do not purchase God’s signs for a small price. Those have their reward with their Lord. O believers, endure, outdo one another in endurance, be stationed, and fear God, that you may succeed.
3:181–184 God is poor; fire-offering demand; denied messengers

Heard saying: God is poor, we are rich. Written along with killing prophets without right. Fire. They demand a messenger who brings an offering fire consumes. Say: messengers already came with signs and with that which you stipulated — why did you kill them? If they deny you, they denied messengers before who came with bayyināt, zubur, and the illuminating Book.

QB-0081: fire-consuming offering evokes Elijah on Carmel (1 Kgs 18) and the tabernacle/Temple fire that consumes the offering (Lev 9:24; 1 Kgs 18:38). The Quran treats the demand as a delaying condition already satisfied and already betrayed by prophet-killing. “God is poor” is a taunt; tafsir ties it to 2:245’s good-loan verse — TRADITION for the occasion.
3:185–186 death; test in wealth and selves; injury from Book-people

Every soul tastes death; full wage at the Rising; success is being pulled from the Fire into the Garden. World-life is matāʿ al-ghurūr. You will be tested in amwāl and anfus. You will hear much adhā from those given the Book before you and from those who associate. Ṣabr and taqwā are ʿazm al-umūr. The injury-from-Book-people line keeps 3:186 in the same file as 3:113’s righteous remnant: both sentences stand.
3:187 covenant to make the Book clear; they sold it

Covenant of those given the Book: make it clear to people, do not conceal it. They threw it behind their backs and bought a small price. Repeats 2:159 / 2:174 / 3:78. Concealment and cheap sale, not yet a global manuscript-corruption theorem.

Heavens, earth, night and day: signs for those of lubb. They remember God standing, sitting, on their sides, and think about creation: You did not create this bāṭilan. Protect us from the Fire. We heard a caller calling to īmān and we believed. Forgive sins and excess; firm feet; help against the kāfir people; give what You promised through Your messengers; do not disgrace us; You do not break the promise.
Same cadence as 2:286 and 3:8–9 / 3:16 / 3:147. The surah that opened with ḥayy qayyūm closes in a creation-and-Fire prayer.

I do not waste the work of a worker among you, male or female — some of you from some. Emigrants, expelled, harmed in My way, who fought and were killed: evils wiped, Gardens. Explicit male-female parity of accepted work in this verse.

Do not let the kāfirūn’s turning-about in the land deceive you — brief enjoyment, then Jahannam. Those who fear their Lord: Gardens, hospitality; what is with God is better for the abrār. Among the People of the Book are those who believe in God and what was sent down to you and what was sent down to them, khāshiʿīn, who do not sell the signs. Their reward is with their Lord.
3:199 is the last People-of-the-Book window in this surah. It sits after 3:85 and beside 3:113. QI-0004 remains OPEN: the muṣḥaf keeps remnant-language next to exclusive-dīn language.

O believers: iṣbirū, ṣābirū, rābiṭū, ittaqū llāh — endure, outlast one another in endurance, be stationed, fear God — that you may succeed. A four-imperative close after a surah of family-narrative, exclusive-dīn claims, and a lost battle.

Āl ʿImrān named the Torah and Injīl as sent-down guidance, set muḥkam against mutashābih, said the dīn with God is islām and that a dīn other than islām will not be accepted, then told Mary’s and Jesus’ story with an Adam-analogy against sonship, offered a common word, pulled Abraham out of both later labels, set the first House at Bakka, called this community the best ummah and immediately said the Book-people are not alike, named Muḥammad as only a mortal messenger, diagnosed Uḥud as dispute-after-gains, and closed with a remnant among the People of the Book who believe in what was sent down to you and to them.
Next canonical surah: S004 al-Nisāʾ. First packet 4:1–28 (creation from one nafs; orphan and marriage law; the four-and-the-twenties inheritance math that will interact with 2:180).
POSSIBLE RELATIONSHIP to 1 Kgs 18 / Lev 9 fire-from-heaven offerings
God is poor taunt; prophet-killing written; fire-offering demand already met and betrayed
Every soul tastes death; tested in wealth and selves; injury from Book-people and mushrikun
Covenant to make the Book clear; they sold it cheap
Creation not in vain; standing-sitting-side remembrance; caller to faith heard
Work of male and female not wasted; emigrants promised Gardens
Among People of the Book some believe in what was sent to you and to them; endure and be stationed

pickthall.name: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓمٓ
verses.itani: Alif, Lam, Meem.
verses.pickthall: Alim. Lam. Mim.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ
verses.itani: God, there is no god but He, the Living, the Eternal.
verses.pickthall: Allah! There is no god save Him, the Alive, the Eternal.

verses.arabic: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ
verses.itani: He sent down to you the Book with the Truth, confirming what came before it; and He sent down the Torah and the Gospel.
verses.pickthall: He hath revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture with truth, confirming that which was (revealed) before it, even as He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.

verses.arabic: مِن قَبْلُ هُدًۭى لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌۭ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
verses.itani: Aforetime, as guidance for mankind; and He sent down the Criterion. Those who have rejected God’s signs will have a severe punishment. God is Mighty, Able to take revenge.
verses.pickthall: Aforetime, for a guidance to mankind; and hath revealed the Criterion (of right and wrong). Lo! those who disbelieve the revelations of Allah, theirs will be a heavy doom. Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
verses.itani: Nothing is hidden from God, on earth or in the heaven.
verses.pickthall: Lo! nothing in the earth or in the heavens is hidden from Allah.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ ۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.itani: It is He who forms you in the wombs as He wills. There is no god except He, the Almighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who fashioneth you in the wombs as pleaseth Him. There is no Allah save Him, the Almighty, the Wise.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَٰتٌۭ مُّحْكَمَٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَٰبِهَٰتٌۭ ۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌۭ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَٰبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّۭ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.itani: It is He who revealed to you the Book. Some of its verses are definitive; they are the foundation of the Book, and others are unspecific. As for those in whose hearts is deviation, they follow the unspecific part, seeking descent, and seeking to derive an interpretation. But none knows its interpretation except God and those firmly rooted in knowledge say, “We believe in it; all is from our Lord.” But none recollects except those with understanding.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture wherein are clear revelations - they are the substance of the Book - and others (which are) allegorical. But those in whose hearts is doubt pursue, forsooth, that which is allegorical seeking (to cause) dissension by seeking to explain it. None knoweth its explanation save Allah. And those who are of sound instruction say: We believe therein; the whole is from our Lord; but only men of understanding really heed.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.itani: “Our Lord, do not cause our hearts to swerve after You have guided us, and bestow on us mercy from Your presence; You are the Giver.”
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! Cause not our hearts to stray after Thou hast guided us, and bestow upon us mercy from Thy Presence. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Bestower.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍۢ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
verses.itani: “Our Lord, You will gather the people for a Day in which there is no doubt.” God will never break His promise.
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! Lo! it is Thou Who gatherest mankind together to a Day of which there is no doubt. Lo! Allah faileth not to keep the tryst.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ وَقُودُ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.itani: As for those who disbelieve, neither their wealth nor their children will avail them anything against God. These will be fuel for the Fire.
verses.pickthall: (On that Day) neither the riches nor the progeny of those who disbelieve will aught avail them with Allah. They will be fuel for Fire.

verses.arabic: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.itani: Like the behavior of Pharaoh’s people and those before them. They rejected Our signs, so God seized them for their sins. God is Strict in retribution.
verses.pickthall: Like Pharaoh's folk and those who were before them, they disbelieved Our revelations and so Allah seized them for their sins. And Allah is severe in punishment.

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَتُغْلَبُونَ وَتُحْشَرُونَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.itani: Say to those who disbelieve, “You will be defeated, and rounded up into Hell—an awful resting-place.”
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad) unto those who disbelieve: Ye shall be overcome and gathered unto Hell, an evil resting-place.

verses.arabic: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ ءَايَةٌۭ فِى فِئَتَيْنِ ٱلْتَقَتَا ۖ فِئَةٌۭ تُقَٰتِلُ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُخْرَىٰ كَافِرَةٌۭ يَرَوْنَهُم مِّثْلَيْهِمْ رَأْىَ ٱلْعَيْنِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
verses.itani: There was a sign for you in the two parties that met. One party fighting in the way of God, and the other was disbelieving. They saw them with their own eyes twice their number. But God supports with His help whomever He wills. In that is a lesson for those with insight.
verses.pickthall: There was a token for you in two hosts which met: one army fighting in the way of Allah, and another disbelieving, whom they saw as twice their number, clearly, with their very eyes. Thus Allah strengtheneth with His succour whom He will. Lo! herein verily is a lesson for those who have eyes.

verses.arabic: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱلْقَنَٰطِيرِ ٱلْمُقَنطَرَةِ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْفِضَّةِ وَٱلْخَيْلِ ٱلْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ وَٱلْحَرْثِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسْنُ ٱلْمَـَٔابِ
verses.itani: Adorned for the people is the love of desires, such as women, and children, and piles upon piles of gold and silver, and branded horses, and livestock, and fields. These are the conveniences of the worldly life, but with God lies the finest resort.
verses.pickthall: Beautified for mankind is love of the joys (that come) from women and offspring; and stored-up heaps of gold and silver, and horses branded (with their mark), and cattle and land. That is comfort of the life of the world. Allah! With Him is a more excellent abode.

verses.arabic: ۞ قُلْ أَؤُنَبِّئُكُم بِخَيْرٍۢ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَأَزْوَٰجٌۭ مُّطَهَّرَةٌۭ وَرِضْوَٰنٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.itani: Say, “Shall I inform you of something better than that? For those who are righteous, with their Lord are Gardens beneath which rivers flow, where they will remain forever, and purified spouses, and acceptance from God.” God is Observant of the servants.
verses.pickthall: Say: Shall I inform you of something better than that? For those who keep from evil, with their Lord, are Gardens underneath which rivers flow wherein they will abide, and pure companions, and contentment from Allah. Allah is Seer of His bondmen,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.itani: Those who say, “Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us our sins, and save us from the suffering of the Fire.”
verses.pickthall: Those who say: Our Lord! Lo! we believe. So forgive us our sins and guard us from the punishment of Fire;

verses.arabic: ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ وَٱلْقَٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْمُنفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِٱلْأَسْحَارِ
verses.itani: The patient, and the truthful, and the reverent, and the charitable, and the seekers of forgiveness at dawn.
verses.pickthall: The steadfast, and the truthful, and the obedient, those who spend (and hoard not), those who pray for pardon in the watches of the night.

verses.arabic: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.itani: God bears witness that there is no god but He, as do the angels, and those endowed with knowledge—upholding justice. There is no god but He, the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: Allah (Himself) is Witness that there is no Allah save Him. And the angels and the men of learning (too are witness). Maintaining His creation in justice, there is no Allah save Him the Almighty, the Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمُ ۗ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.itani: Religion with God is Islam. Those to whom the Scripture was given differed only after knowledge came to them, out of envy among themselves. Whoever rejects the signs of God—God is quick to take account.
verses.pickthall: Lo! religion with Allah (is) the Surrender (to His Will and Guidance). Those who (formerly) received the Scripture differed only after knowledge came unto them, through transgression among themselves. Whoso disbelieveth the revelations of Allah (will find that) lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ حَآجُّوكَ فَقُلْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّهِ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِ ۗ وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْأُمِّيِّۦنَ ءَأَسْلَمْتُمْ ۚ فَإِنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟ ۖ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.itani: If they argue with you, say, “I have surrendered myself to God, and those who follow me.” And say to those who were given the Scripture, and to the unlearned, “Have you surrendered?” If they have surrendered, then they are guided; but if they turn away, then your duty is to convey. God is Seeing of the servants.
verses.pickthall: And if they argue with thee, (O Muhammad), say: I have surrendered my purpose to Allah and (so have) those who follow me. And say unto those who have received the Scripture and those who read not: Have ye (too) surrendered? If they surrender, then truly they are rightly guided, and if they turn away, then it is thy duty only to convey the message (unto them). Allah is Seer of (His) bondmen.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّۢ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.itani: As for those who defy God’s revelations, and kill the prophets unjustly, and kill those who advocate justice among the people—promise them a painful retribution.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve the revelations of Allah, and slay the prophets wrongfully, and slay those of mankind who enjoin equity: promise them a painful doom.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
verses.itani: They are those whose deeds will come to nothing, in this world and in the Hereafter; and they will have no saviors.
verses.pickthall: Those are they whose works have failed in the world and the Hereafter; and they have no helpers.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ نَصِيبًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ وَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.itani: Have you not considered those who were given a share of the Scripture, as they were called to the Scripture of God to arbitrate between them; then some of them turned back, and declined?
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how those who have received a portion of the Scripture invoke the Scripture of Allah (in their disputes) that it may judge between them; then a faction of them turn away, being opposed (to it)?

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًۭا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍۢ ۖ وَغَرَّهُمْ فِى دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.itani: That is because they said, “The Fire will not touch us except for a limited number of days.” They have been misled in their religion by the lies they fabricated.
verses.pickthall: That is because they say: The Fire will not touch us save for a certain number of days. That which they used to invent hath deceived them regarding their religion.

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جَمَعْنَٰهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.itani: How about when We gather them for a Day in which there is no doubt, and each soul will be paid in full for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged?
verses.pickthall: How (will it be with them) when We have brought them all together to a Day of which there is no doubt, when every soul will be paid in full what it hath earned, and they will not be wronged.

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
verses.itani: Say, “O God, Owner of Sovereignty. You grant sovereignty to whom You will, and You strip sovereignty from whom you will. You honor whom you will, and You humiliate whom you will. In Your hand is all goodness. You are Capable of all things.”
verses.pickthall: Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt. Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt. In Thy hand is the good. Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.

verses.arabic: تُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ۖ وَتَرْزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
verses.itani: “You merge the night into the day, and You merge the day into the night; and you bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living; and You provide for whom you will without measure.”
verses.pickthall: Thou causest the night to pass into the day, and Thou causest the day to pass into the night. And Thou bringest forth the living from the dead, and Thou bringest forth the dead from the living. And Thou givest sustenance to whom Thou choosest, without stint.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَتَّخِذِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ فِى شَىْءٍ إِلَّآ أَن تَتَّقُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ تُقَىٰةًۭ ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.itani: Believers are not to take disbelievers for friends instead of believers. Whoever does that has nothing to do with God, unless it is to protect your own selves against them. God warns you to beware of Him. To God is the destiny.
verses.pickthall: Let not the believers take disbelievers for their friends in preference to believers. Whoso doeth that hath no connection with Allah unless (it be) that ye but guard yourselves against them, taking (as it were) security. Allah biddeth you beware (only) of Himself. Unto Allah is the journeying.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن تُخْفُوا۟ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ أَوْ تُبْدُوهُ يَعْلَمْهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
verses.itani: Say, “Whether you conceal what is in your hearts, or disclose it, God knows it.” He knows everything in the heavens and the earth. God is Powerful over everything.
verses.pickthall: Say, (O Muhammad): Whether ye hide that which is in your breasts or reveal it, Allah knoweth it. He knoweth that which is in the heavens and that which is in the earth, and Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ مُّحْضَرًۭا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ تَوَدُّ لَوْ أَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُۥٓ أَمَدًۢا بَعِيدًۭا ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.itani: On the Day when every soul finds all the good it has done presented. And as for the evil it has done, it will wish there were a great distance between them. God cautions you of Himself. God is Kind towards the servants.
verses.pickthall: On the Day when every soul will find itself confronted with all that it hath done of good and all that it hath done of evil (every soul) will long that there might be a mighty space of distance between it and that (evil). Allah biddeth you beware of Him. And Allah is Full of Pity for (His) bondmen.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱللَّهَ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى يُحْبِبْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: Say, “If you love God, then follow me, and God will love you, and will forgive you your sins.” God is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.pickthall: Say, (O Muhammad, to mankind): If ye love Allah, follow me; Allah will love you and forgive you your sins. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.itani: Say, “Obey God and the Messenger.” But if they turn away—God does not love the faithless.
verses.pickthall: Say: Obey Allah and the messenger. But if they turn away, lo! Allah loveth not the disbelievers (in His guidance).

verses.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ وَنُوحًۭا وَءَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَءَالَ عِمْرَٰنَ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.itani: God chose Adam, and Noah, and the family of Abraham, and the family of Imran, over all mankind.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah preferred Adam and Noah and the Family of Abraham and the Family of 'Imran above (all His) creatures.

verses.arabic: ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.itani: Offspring one of the other. God is Hearer and Knower.
verses.pickthall: They were descendants one of another. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.itani: The wife of Imran said, “My Lord, I have vowed to You what is in my womb, dedicated, so accept from me; You are the Hearer and Knower.”
verses.pickthall: (Remember) when the wife of 'Imran said: My Lord! I have vowed unto Thee that which is in my belly as a consecrated (offering). Accept it from me. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Hearer, the Knower!

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَضَعْتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۖ وَإِنِّى سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّىٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
verses.itani: And when she delivered her, she said, “My Lord, I have delivered a female,” and God was well aware of what she has delivered, “and the male is not like the female, and I have named her Mary, and have commended her and her descendants to Your protection, from Satan the outcast.”
verses.pickthall: And when she was delivered she said: My Lord! Lo! I am delivered of a female - Allah knew best of what she was delivered - the male is not as the female; and lo! I have named her Mary, and lo! I crave Thy protection for her and for her offspring from Satan the outcast.

verses.arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.itani: Her Lord accepted her with a gracious reception, and brought her a beautiful upbringing, and entrusted her to the care of Zechariah. Whenever Zechariah entered upon her in the sanctuary, he found her with provision. He said, “O Mary, where did you get this from?” She said, “It is from God; God provides to whom He wills without reckoning.”
verses.pickthall: And her Lord accepted her with full acceptance and vouchsafed to her a goodly growth; and made Zachariah her guardian. Whenever Zachariah went into the sanctuary where she was, he found that she had food. He said: O Mary! Whence cometh unto thee this (food)? She answered: It is from Allah. Allah giveth without stint to whom He will.

verses.arabic: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةًۭ طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verses.itani: Thereupon Zechariah prayed to his Lord; he said, “My Lord, bestow on me good offspring from Your presence; You are the Hearer of Prayers.”
verses.pickthall: Then Zachariah prayed unto his Lord and said: My Lord! Bestow upon me of Thy bounty goodly offspring. Lo! Thou art the Hearer of Prayer.

verses.arabic: فَنَادَتْهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٌۭ يُصَلِّى فِى ٱلْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۢا بِكَلِمَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًۭا وَحَصُورًۭا وَنَبِيًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.itani: Then the angels called out to him, as he stood praying in the sanctuary: “God gives you good news of John; confirming a Word from God, and honorable, and moral, and a prophet; one of the upright.”
verses.pickthall: And the angels called to him as he stood praying in the sanctuary: Allah giveth thee glad tidings of (a son whose name is) John, (who cometh) to confirm a word from Allah lordly, chaste, a prophet of the righteous.

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verses.itani: He said, “My Lord, how will I have a son, when old age has overtaken me, and my wife is barren?” He said, “Even so, God does whatever He wills.”
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when age hath overtaken me already and my wife is barren? (The angel) answered: So (it will be). Allah doeth what He will.

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًۭا ۗ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرًۭا وَسَبِّحْ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَٰرِ
verses.itani: He said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you shall not speak to the people for three days, except by gestures. And remember your Lord much, and praise in the evening and the morning.”
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Appoint a token for me. (The angel) said: The token unto thee (shall be) that thou shalt not speak unto mankind three days except by signs. Remember thy Lord much, and praise (Him) in the early hours of night and morning.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.itani: The angels said, “O Mary, God has chosen you, and has purified you. He has chosen you over all the women of the world.
verses.pickthall: And when the angels said: O Mary! Lo! Allah hath chosen thee and made thee pure, and hath preferred thee above (all) the women of creation.

verses.arabic: يَٰمَرْيَمُ ٱقْنُتِى لِرَبِّكِ وَٱسْجُدِى وَٱرْكَعِى مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ
verses.itani: “O Mary, be devoted to your Lord, and bow down, and kneel with those who kneel.”
verses.pickthall: O Mary! Be obedient to thy Lord, prostrate thyself and bow with those who bow (in worship).

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَٰمَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.itani: These are accounts from the Unseen, which We reveal to you. You were not with them when they cast their lots as to which of them would take charge of Mary; nor were you with them as they quarreled.
verses.pickthall: This is of the tidings of things hidden. We reveal it unto thee (Muhammad). Thou wast not present with them when they threw their pens (to know) which of them should be the guardian of Mary, nor wast thou present with them when they quarrelled (thereupon).

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ ٱسْمُهُ ٱلْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًۭا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.itani: The Angels said, “O Mary, God gives you good news of a Word from Him. His name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, well-esteemed in this world and the next, and one of the nearest.
verses.pickthall: (And remember) when the angels said: O Mary! Lo! Allah giveth thee glad tidings of a word from him, whose name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, illustrious in the world and the Hereafter, and one of those brought near (unto Allah).

verses.arabic: وَيُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.itani: He will speak to the people from the crib, and in adulthood, and will be one of the righteous.”
verses.pickthall: He will speak unto mankind in his cradle and in his manhood, and he is of the righteous.

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى وَلَدٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.itani: She said, “My Lord, how can I have a child, when no man has touched me?” He said, “It will be so. God creates whatever He wills. To have anything done, He only says to it, ‘Be,’ and it is.”
verses.pickthall: She said: My Lord! How can I have a child when no mortal hath touched me? He said: So (it will be). Allah createth what He will. If He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.
